title: Unraveling the Molecular Mechanisms Linking Cigarette Smoke Exposure to Skin Damage.
authors: Tan, Ziyi; Wei, Yuping; Zhang, Shengan; Song, Jianping; Zhu, Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究香烟烟雾致皮肤损伤的分子机制，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: CS is an environmental pollutant everywhere, but we still do not fully know how it hurts our skin. This study integrates LC-MS, network toxicology, molecular docking, and experimental validation in order to understand how CS causes skin involvement at the molecular level. By searching a database, constructing a PPI network and analyzing GO/KEGG, we found 57 candidate targets related to CS-induced skin damage. We found that STAT3, AKT1, TP53, CASP3 and IL-6 play the core roles, and PI3K-Akt, p53, JAK-STAT and apoptosis pathways may be crucial. Molecular docking analysis confirmed strong interactions between components of CS and these key targets. In vitro validation using HaCaT cells showed that CS exposure decreased expressions of STAT3 and AKT, but increased p53, CASP3 and IL-6. The inhibition of PI3K-AKT- and JAK-STAT-related responses, coupled with the initiation of p53-driven apoptosis, led to the observed cytotoxicity, functional impairment, oxidative stress and inflammation, which induced and aggravated skin damage. These findings provide a new perspective on the harmful effects of CS on the skin, providing both a theoretical basis for strengthening regulatory measures to limit exposure and opening new avenues for exploring relevant prevention strategies.
abstract_zh: CS是一种无处不在的环境污染物，但我们对其如何损害皮肤的了解仍不全面。本研究整合了LC-MS、网络毒理学、分子对接及实验验证，旨在从分子层面揭示CS引发皮肤损伤的机制。通过数据库检索、构建PPI网络及GO/KEGG分析，我们发现了57个与CS诱导皮肤损伤相关的候选靶点。研究发现STAT3、AKT1、TP53、CASP3和IL-6发挥核心作用，而PI3K-Akt、p53、JAK-STAT及凋亡通路可能至关重要。分子对接分析证实了CS组分与这些关键靶点之间存在强相互作用。使用HaCaT细胞的体外验证显示，CS暴露降低了STAT3和AKT的表达，但增加了p53、CASP3和IL-6的水平。PI3K-AKT和JAK-STAT相关反应的抑制，加上p53驱动的凋亡启动，导致了观察到的细胞毒性、功能损伤、氧化应激和炎症，从而诱导并加重了皮肤损伤。这些发现为CS对皮肤的有害影响提供了新视角，既为加强限制暴露的监管措施提供了理论基础，也为探索相关预防策略开辟了新途径。
